verdict.rationale: USPTO's own pages say Trademark Center is where you file a new trademark application and pay the related fees, and that fees can be paid online by card, deposit account or EFT. Patent Center supports online submission of patent applications with separate submission and payment receipts, and the required identity verification can also be done online. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that a founder completed a filing and payment end to end online.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Trademark Center is where you can file a new trademark application, pay application-related fees
We accept credit cards, debit cards that do not require a PIN, deposit accounts, or EFT (U.S. bank account only) when paying online.
Separate submission and payment receipts clearly confirms status of submitted documents and successful payments
Setting up a USPTO.gov account gives you access to file patent and trademark applications, track your submissions, and manage your intellectual property all in one secure place.
this one-time verification process can be completed online in less than 15 minutes.
